office: the Civil Status Division, Department of Immigration and Civil Status

routes.label: at the Identity Card Office, Independence House, Victoria, or the Pension Fund Complex, Grand Anse, Praslin

note: The Department of Immigration and Civil Status: every resident of Seychelles must hold a valid National Identity Card; all cards are valid ten years; the first card is free, and an expired card is exchanged for a new one at no charge (a lost card costs SCR 150 with a police statement, not modelled). Those under 16 are not photographed. The time isn't stated.

sources.title: Seychelles Department of Immigration and Civil Status, FAQ: ID section
sources.said: The holder must present the expired card at the I.D Card Office at Independence House, to be issued with a new one, with no charge ... The holder must produce a police statement at the I.D Card Office, at a cost of SCR 150/- ... All I.D cards are valid for a period of 10 years. ... The I.D card is free of charge on first issuance

sources.title: Seychelles Department of Immigration and Civil Status, National Identity Card
sources.said: It is mandatory for all residents of Seychelles to hold a ... valid ... National Identity Card. It serves as a proof of identity and used when conducting any official transaction. ... Persons ... below the age of 16 ... years old ... do not have their photo taken.
